# Connecting LLM

```{r}

install.packages(c("ellmer", "usethis"))

```

```{r}
file.edit(path.expand("~/.Renviron"))
```

I put in the Gemini API Key. Now let's test it

```{r}

library(ellmer)

# Check API key
if (Sys.getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY") == "") {
  stop("Gemini API key not found.")
}

# Connect to Gemini
chat <- chat_google_gemini(
  model = "gemini-3.8-flash",
  system_prompt = paste(
    "You are a research assistant analyzing",
    "mining contracts in the Democratic Republic",
    "of the Congo.",
    "Extract only information supported by the text.",
    "Do not invent contractual obligations",
    "or supporting quotations."
  )
)

# Test connection
chat$chat("Say hello in one sentence.")
```

This is our first LLM language output and it is working.

Define the research

```{r}

# Define research variables

extraction_schema <- type_object(

  classification = type_enum(
    c(
      "explicit_obligation",
      "general_reference",
      "not_identified"
    ),
    "Whether the passage contains an explicit environmental obligation, a general reference, or neither."
  ),

  responsible_party = type_string(
    "Party responsible for the obligation, or NOT_STATED."
  ),

  obligation = type_string(
    "Describe the environmental obligation, or NOT_FOUND."
  ),

  evidence_quote = type_string(
    "Exact quotation from the original text supporting the classification. Use NOT_FOUND if no relevant passage exists."
  ),

  explanation = type_string(
    "Brief explanation of the classification."
  )
)
```

send to gemini

```{r}
chat <- chat_google_gemini(
  model = "gemini-3.8-flash",

  system_prompt = paste(
    "You are a research assistant analyzing",
    "French-language mining agreements.",
    "Identify contractual environmental obligations.",
    "Distinguish explicit obligations from general references.",
    "Do not confuse legal definitions with contractual obligations.",
    "Do not invent information or quotations.",
    "Base your answer only on the provided text."
  )
)

# Prepare prompt
extraction_prompt <- paste0(
  "Analyze this page of a mining agreement.\n",
  "Identify the clearest environmental obligation,",
  " if one exists.\n",
  "If there are several, select one for this initial test.\n",
  "Use exact supporting quotations from the original text.\n",
  "The absence of an obligation on this page does not",
  " mean it is absent from the contract.\n\n",
  "PAGE TEXT:\n",
  test_page$text[1]
)

# Ask Gemini to extract structured data
extraction <- chat$chat_structured(
  extraction_prompt,
  type = extraction_schema
)

print(extraction)
```

Now testing whether the quotes given by gemini are real 

```{r}


# Clean text
normalize_text <- function(x) {

  # Replace HTML line breaks with spaces
  x <- gsub(
    "<br\\s*/?>",
    " ",
    x,
    ignore.case = TRUE,
    perl = TRUE
  )

  # Remove extra whitespace
  x <- gsub("[[:space:]]+", " ", x)

  # Remove leading and trailing spaces
  trimws(x)
}

# Verify Gemini's quotation
quote_found <- grepl(
  normalize_text(extraction$evidence_quote),
  normalize_text(test_page$text[1]),
  fixed = TRUE
)

print(quote_found)


```

## Whole contract extraction

```{r}


# Combine all pages, keeping their page numbers
full_contract_text <- page_text |>
  dplyr::arrange(page) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    labeled_text = paste0(
      "[PAGE ", page, "]\n",

nchar(full_contract_text)

# Preview beginning

```

## Define what Gemini Should Extract

```{R}

library(ellmer)

# Structure for extracting multiple environmental obligations
full_schema <- type_object(
  obligations = type_array(
    type_object(
      page = type_integer(
        "Source page number"
      ),
      responsible_party = type_string(
        "Party responsible for the obligation"
      ),
      obligation = type_string(
        "Brief description in English"
      ),
      evidence_quote = type_string(
        "Exact supporting quotation in the original language"
      ),
      specificity = type_enum(
        c("general", "specific", "quantified"),
        "General compliance requirement, specific action, or requirement with a measurable amount or deadline"
      )
    ),
    description = "All distinct explicit environmental obligations. Return an empty array if none are identified."
  )
)
```

Analyse entire agreement with gemini

```{r}
chat_full <- chat_google_gemini(
  model = "gemini-3.8-flash",
  system_prompt = paste(
    "You are conducting systematic content analysis",
    "of mining contracts.",
    "Identify explicit environmental obligations.",
    "Do not confuse contractual obligations with",
    "definitions, general aspirations, or background law.",
    "Use only the provided contract text.",
    "Do not invent quotations or page numbers.",
    "Do not make claims about legal enforceability."
  )
)

full_prompt <- paste0(
  "Examine the entire mining agreement.\n",
  "Identify ALL distinct environmental obligations,\n",
  "including pollution prevention, rehabilitation,\n",
  "environmental assessments, compliance and monitoring.\n\n",
  "For each obligation, provide the responsible party,\n",
  "page number, an English description, an exact quotation,\n",
  "and its specificity.\n\n",
  "Do not repeat the same obligation multiple times.\n",
  "If no obligations are identified, return an empty array.\n\n",
  full_contract_text
)

# File for saving result
output_file <- paste0(
  "data/processed/full_environmental_",
  test_id,
  ".rds"
)

dir.create("data/processed",
           recursive = TRUE,
           showWarnings = FALSE)

# only call for new file
if (file.exists(output_file)) {

  saved_result <- readRDS(output_file)
  full_extraction <- saved_result$result

} else {

  full_extraction <- chat_full$chat_structured(
    full_prompt,
    type = full_schema
  )

  saveRDS(
    list(
      contract_id = test_id,
      model = "gemini-3.8-flash",
      prompt = full_prompt,
      extraction_date = Sys.time(),
      result = full_extraction
    ),
    output_file
  )
}

print(full_extraction)
```

}

print(obligations, n = Inf)

## Validate Whole-Contract Extraction

```{r}

# check quotations against source text

obligations$quote_verified <- vapply(
  seq_len(nrow(obligations)),
  function(i) {

    # Find original page
    source <- page_text$text_clean[
      page_text$page == obligations$page[i]
    ]

    # Get Gemini's quotation
    quote <- as.character(
      obligations$evidence_quote[i]
    )

    # Handle missing pages or quotations
    if (length(source) == 0 ||
        is.na(quote) ||
        !nzchar(quote)) {
      return(FALSE)
    }

    # Verify  
    any(grepl(
      normalize_text(quote),
      normalize_text(source),
      fixed = TRUE
    ))
  },
  logical(1)
)

# validation result
obligations |>
  select(
    page,
    obligation,
    specificity,
    quote_verified
  ) |>
  print(width = Inf)
```
note: this checks whether the quote gemini returned actually exists, not whether it's interpreted correctly

```{r}

# Save validated table
write_csv(
  obligations,
  "data/processed/environmental_obligations_pilot.csv"
)
```

# Automated Full-Document Extraction


```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ellmer)

# Analyze all agreements
ids_to_analyze <- jva_inventory$id

dir.create(
  "data/processed",
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

for (id in ids_to_analyze) {

  output_file <- paste0(
    "data/processed/full_environmental_",
    id,
    ".rds"
  )

  # Skip agreements already analyzed
  if (file.exists(output_file)) next

  tryCatch({

    # Load document text
    pages <- readRDS(
      paste0("data/raw/contract_text/", id, ".rds")
    )

    # Clean text while keeping page numbers
    pages <- pages |>
      mutate(
        text_clean = vapply(
          text,
          normalize_text,
          character(1)
        )
      )

    # Combine complete agreement
    full_text <- pages |>
      arrange(page) |>
      mutate(
        labeled = paste0(
          "[PAGE ", page, "]\n",
          text_clean
        )
      ) |>
      pull(labeled) |>
      paste(collapse = "\n\n")

    # Prepare research prompt
    prompt <- paste0(
      "Analyze this entire mining agreement.\n",
      "Identify all distinct explicit environmental ",
      "obligations established by its provisions.\n",
      "Include environmental compliance, rehabilitation, ",
      "pollution prevention, assessments and monitoring.\n",
      "Exclude definitions, general aspirations and ",
      "unrelated legal background.\n",
      "For each obligation, provide the responsible ",
      "party, page, English description, exact original ",
      "quotation and specificity.\n",
      "Do not invent information or repeat obligations.\n\n",
      full_text
    )

    # Fresh session for each agreement
    chat <- chat_google_gemini(
      model = "gemini-3.8-flash",
      system_prompt = paste(
        "You conduct systematic content analysis",
        "of mining contracts.",
        "Report only explicitly supported obligations.",
        "Do not invent information or quotations.",
        "Use the supplied page numbers."
      )
    )

    # Extract structured observations
    result <- chat$chat_structured(
      prompt,
      type = full_schema
    )

    # Preserve research outputs
    saveRDS(
      list(
        contract_id = id,
        model = "gemini-3.8-flash",
        prompt = prompt,
        extracted_at = Sys.time(),
        result = result
      ),
      output_file
    )

    message(
      "Completed contract ", id,
      ": ", length(result$obligations),
      " obligations"
    )

  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Failed contract ", id, ": ", e$message)
  })

  Sys.sleep(60)
}
```

```{r}

# Validate quotations, including those crossing page boundaries

# Normalize text
normalize_for_match <- function(x) {

  #  HTML formatting
  x <- gsub("<br\\s*/?>", " ", x,
            ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<[^>]+>", " ", x)

  # Invisible characters and apostrophes
  x <- gsub("[\u00A0\uFEFF\u200B]", " ", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("[\u2018\u2019]", "'", x, perl = TRUE)

  # whitespace
  x <- gsub("[[:space:]]+", " ", x)

  trimws(x)
}


verify_contract <- function(file) {

  saved <- readRDS(file)
  id <- saved$contract_id

  obs <- tibble::as_tibble(
    saved$result$obligations
  )

  if (nrow(obs) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble())
  }

  # Load source pages
  pages <- readRDS(
    paste0("data/raw/contract_text/", id, ".rds")
  )

  pages <- pages[order(pages$page), ]

  # Verify each quotation
  obs$quote_verified <- vapply(
    seq_len(nrow(obs)),
    function(i) {

      pg <- as.integer(obs$page[i])
      quote <- as.character(obs$evidence_quote[i])

      if (is.na(pg) || is.na(quote) ||
          !nzchar(quote) ||
          !(pg %in% pages$page)) {
        return(FALSE)
      }

      # Check the cited page alone and with its neighbors
      candidates <- list(
        pages$text[pages$page == pg],
        pages$text[pages$page %in% c(pg, pg + 1)],
        pages$text[pages$page %in% c(pg - 1, pg)]
      )

      any(vapply(
        candidates,
        function(part) {

          source <- normalize_for_match(
            paste(part, collapse = " ")
          )

          quote_clean <- normalize_for_match(quote)

          grepl(quote_clean, source, fixed = TRUE)
        },
        logical(1)
      ))
    },
    logical(1)
  )

  obs |>
    dplyr::mutate(contract_id = id, .before = 1)
}

# Read all saved extractions
result_files <- list.files(
  "data/processed",
  pattern = "^full_environmental_[0-9]+\\.rds$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Combine and verify all observations
all_obligations <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(result_files, verify_contract)
)

# Display the results
all_obligations |>
  dplyr::select(
    contract_id,
    page,
    obligation,
    quote_verified
  ) |>
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)

```

```{r}

# quotes needing manual verification

all_obligations |>
  dplyr::filter(!quote_verified) |>
  dplyr::select(
    contract_id,
    page,
    evidence_quote
  ) |>
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)

```

## Investigate Unverified Quotations

```{r}

# Select quotations that failed verification
failed_quotes <- all_obligations |>
  filter(!quote_verified)

# Compare with source pages
for (i in seq_len(nrow(failed_quotes))) {

  id <- failed_quotes$contract_id[i]
  pg <- failed_quotes$page[i]

  pages <- readRDS(
    paste0("data/raw/contract_text/", id, ".rds")
  )

  original <- pages$text[pages$page == pg]

  cat("\n\nCONTRACT:", id, "PAGE:", pg, "\n")

  cat("\nGEMINI QUOTATION:\n")
  cat(failed_quotes$evidence_quote[i])

  cat("\n\nORIGINAL PAGE:\n")
  cat(normalize_text(original))

  cat("\n\n--------------------------\n")
}

```

Methods changes: updated environmental key words becuase french word environ (which means approximately) was creating false positive matches. Additionally, verification needs to account for quotes tha tcross over page breaks, so this was added. There is also the issue that some quotes will be one letter off the gemeni quote due to OCR mismatches/errors in the resourcecontracts API.
